table.author: Not asserted: the embedded table info is empty apart from author_website http://www.vpforums.org/; the file name carries the release label S34 v1.1

unbound_bulb_lights.authority: The table's bulb-mesh Lights, every one in its GI collection, which the embedded script switches off while solenoid 15 (Special Relay) is energized. They model general-illumination sockets on the playfield; the drawing set draws the playfield G.I. string with four bulbs and a dashed continuation and prints no count, so these are not evidence of a stock socket quantity or position.

unplaced.solenoid-1: The outhole ball release kicks the drained ball from the outhole into the shooter lane; the table's invisible Drain kicker (414.0, 1827.5) and BallRelease kicker (812.1, 1611.5) are ball-stack helpers, not the coil, and Figure 3's 01 callout under the apron was not measured.
unplaced.switch-19: The retained table models the Left Spinner Standup as a rubber Wall whose one slingshot edge pulses 19 (sw19_Slingshot); the edge is where the table counts a rubber hit, not where the leaf switch is, and Figure 4 was not measured. Candidate geometry is listed in the spatial report.
unplaced.switch-32: The playfield tilt has no table object or script binding; Figure 4 prints 32 near the base of the right flipper but its callout was not measured, and a nudge helper is not its contact.
unplaced.switch-38: The retained table models the Middle Right Standup as a rubber Wall whose one slingshot edge pulses 38 (sw38_Slingshot); the edge is where the table counts a rubber hit, not where the leaf switch is, and Figure 4 was not measured. Candidate geometry is listed in the spatial report.
unplaced.switch-9: The outhole switch has no sensor object: the script's one-ball bsTrough stack sets 9 from the hit handler of the invisible Drain kicker (414.0, 1827.5), a script drain, and Figure 4's dashed 09 callout was not measured.
